core_features: Barcode scan -> immediate product name, price, expiry date display
Multiple batches per product (scanning same barcode twice = two independent batches)
FIFO sorting within each product group (earliest expiry first)
Expiry notifications: configurable alert window (default 3 days) per batch
Offline-first: full scan/inventory from local catalog when offline
Open Food Facts API fallback for unknown barcodes (hybrid lookup)
Manual barcode entry fallback when camera/API fails
Editable product details (name, brand, price, default expiry) with persistence
PWA: installable, offline-cached, push notifications, home-screen install promotion

decided.batching: ADR 0001 Accepted: every scan creates a new batch with its own expiry/quantity; inventory groups by product and sorts batches FIFO by expiry within group.
decided.auth_and_sync: Dexie Cloud (4.4.15) with per-account private realms; schema v11/v12 rekeys catalog by '#'+barcode and settings by '#settings'; cloud database identified by sync URL, not by DB name.
decided.database_name: Database renamed to 'barcode-inventory-v2' (v10 left behind on disk) because IndexedDB cannot change a primary key in place; additive schema upgrade is impossible for the PK change.
decided.mode_persistence: App mode ('shop'|'sell') is device-local in localStorage under 'appMode' with one-time seed from the synced cashierMode setting; NOT synced to the account. Mode is read from ModeContext, not settings.cashierMode.
decided.app_modes: Shop (receive/stock) vs Sell (ring up at the till) is the only two user-visible modes; no 'Seller Mode' exists and was intentionally deleted end-to-end in the cashier-mode plan. Sales is the 4th nav item, visible only in Sell.
decided.scan_internal_mode: Auto/Manual scan toggle (ModeSegmentedControl) remains a separate, internal control inside ScannerScreen for scan behavior; it is distinct from Shop/Sell and uses non-conflicting vocabulary.
decided.till_business_logic: Till: recordSale snapshots name/brand/unitPrice per line, FIFO deduction via sortBatchesByFIFO, shortfall never blocks a paying customer, undoLastSale restores stock exactly (recreating deleted batches), SalesScreen reports daily totals/top sellers.
decided.stock_editing: Set stock: type a target quantity; app adds a batch to reach it or deducts oldest-expiry-first via deductStockFIFO to match.
decided.deployment: GitHub Pages is the deploy target; Vercel is configured (vercel.json, __IS_VERCEL__ basename) but the cashier-mode plan says 'GitHub Pages ONLY. Never deploy to Vercel.'
decided.roadmap: Apple-inspired UI redesign (docs/plans/2026-10-26-apple-inspired-ui-redesign-plan.md) is a report-only plan superseding the slate+emerald refresh; no source files were modified.
decided.replacements: AUDIT_FLOW_NAVIGATION.md is stale (audits a 'Seller Mode' that never existed) and must be corrected or deleted. The 2026-10-19 brainstorm's two claims (swipe-to-delete not implemented; missing focus-visible) are contradicted by code evidence and fixed in docs.
decided.design_tokens: All colours/status come from CSS custom properties in src/index.css (170+ tokens); hardcoded hex in inline styles is being migrated to token classes; status colors resolve through var(--status-*) so badges follow the theme.
decided.access: Focus-visible rings, visually-hidden page headings, one aria-live region per screen, semantic headings, touch targets >= 44x44px, WCAG contrast verified by measurement (badge pairs all >= 4.55:1).
decided.testing_status: Type-check 0 errors; ~431–453 tests green (varies by phase); production build passes; QA fixes (sync error, seed products, cashier toggle, logout, theme, render error, touch targets, fonts) implemented and reviewed.

Two-account isolation test: free tier allows 3 users; no CLI to delete demo users - demo users would consume 2 seats, or use a second real email, or skip the live test and rely on private-ID design + server-side enforcement?
Test isolation: 78 of 264 tests fail with 'SyntaxError: lower version than existing version' (fake-indexedDB 6.2.5 + Dexie 4.4.6 version-conflict); fix mechanism or leave as known non-blocking?
Vercel deployment: plan is GitHub Pages only, but a separate audit targeted Vercel; clarify the authoritative deploy target.
Login bypass: VITE_BYPASS_LOGIN dev/test flag exists; must never be enabled in production - clarify CI/test usage boundaries.
Camera permission: defer the pre-permission prompt (product behaviour change; worth a decision, not a silent edit).
contradictions: AUDIT_FLOW_NAVIGATION.md audits a 'Seller Mode' that never existed in the codebase and recommends UI for it; it is stale and conflicts with the Shop/Sell model in App.tsx/ModeContext/SalesScreen.

2026-10-19-brainstorm-next-phase.md claims swipe-to-delete is not implemented and focus-visible is missing; both are false (BatchRow swipeX implemented; global + 17 component focus-visible rules exist).

Cashier Mode (till) vs Shop/Sell Mode: the cashier-mode plan treats 'cashierMode' as the single switch that routes / to Till and adds Sales to the nav; ModeContext/shop-sell-modes plan treats Shop vs Sell as a device-local mode. The two concepts were merged via ModeContext, but the terminology and the 'cashierMode' boolean are still lingering (cashierMode is retained only as a one-time seed source).
sellerMode flag: removed end-to-end (7 files), but earlier plans/test fixtures referenced it; the settings service still accepts unknown keys (deferred to v1.0.0, harmless).

Deploy target: cashier-mode status says 'GitHub Pages ONLY, never Vercel', while the testing/deployment plan (2026-10-22) and the original architecture report specify Vercel as a secondary target; ambiguous for CI/CD.

Baseline type errors: reports vary (56, then 65, then 55, then 59 errors) across audit documents; the '65 baseline' figure is the stated gate, but the moving number creates confusion about what is pre-existing.

Sync architecture: the 2026-10-15 dexie-cloud-sync plan calls for replacing idb with dexie + dexie-cloud-addon; the account-login plan replaced the local master-password gate with Dexie Cloud email-OTP (Task E); the current dexie.ts uses Dexie 4 + addon with requireAuth/custommoduleLoginGui, and the sync URL is a default embedded constant - a later plan reads VITE_DEXIE_CLOUD_SYNC_URL env var. The env var question is open.

Test harness name conflict: cashier-mode status says DB v2 with 'sales' store and 'catalog' table; current dexie.ts uses version 12 with 'products' table and 'catalog: null'. The catalog table was dropped in the account-login rekey, so any document asserting 'catalog' as the store name contradicts the current schema.

Testing vs production: 78 tests fail under vitest due to the fake-indexedDB/Dexie version conflict, but the app works in production; the fix (upgrade/downgrade fake-indexedDB or replace the mock) is open and blocks CI green.

Login bypass: VITE_BYPASS_LOGIN is a dev/test flag that disables Dexie Cloud requireAuth; if accidentally committed/enabled in production it disables per-account data scoping (the core security property). No CI guard currently prevents the flag from being set in a production build.
Dashboard vs inventory: earlier plans referenced 'Dashboard' screens and a 'Seller Mode' edit-product path; neither exists in the current code; any remaining doc referencing them is stale.

Brand lockup on login: barcode glyph + 'Inventory'/'Barcode Inventory' display type (replacing the bare Mail icon)
Product image system: shelf-tag/barcode-preview instead of the flat grey Package icon, on Inventory cards, Product Detail hero, and the app icon set (192/512 PNG, maskable, apple-touch)
₱ struck-through regular price + bold ₱ price as a brand mark on product cards and product detail
Mode differentiation: Shop = default (green/emerald accent, paper surfaces); Sell = register layer (warm amber till bar, amber accent actions); no separate theme, no jarring switch
CSS foundation: global :focus-visible baseline, fade-in keyframes, consolidated .btn-primary/.btn-secondary, mode-accent tokens, bottom-nav touch targets
Camera viewfinder as the hero: large clean window, thin scan line, start overlay fades in, results cascade in
Bottom nav: icon + label, single active row highlight, reduced height, anchored to safe area
Toasts: single line of text + optional inline action, fades/slides, no pop
Install promotion banner: slim bottom bar, triggered on 3rd visit, single Install action
Interaction: cross-fade screen transitions, press feedback (1-2px scale-down + shadow lift), reduced-motion honoured first
Accessibility: 44x44 touch targets, focus rings, contrast (measured >= 4.5:1), one aria-live region, semantic headings, skip link
must_not_change: Core scan -> save -> inventory flow (scan -> product lookup -> detail form -> add batch -> group + FIFO)
Batch-per-scan model and FIFO expiry ordering; it is ADR 0001 and drives expiry alerts
IndexedDB data model: products (keyed by #+barcode), inventory (batchId), sales (saleId), settings (#settings)
Open Food Facts lookup flow and its rate-limit agreement (100 req/min)
Expiry alert service (per-batch alert window, default 3 days) and push notification path
Dexie Cloud auth/sync: per-account private realms, session persistence, multi-device sharing
Cashier mode behaviour: scan -> cart -> Paid (records sale, snapshots prices, deducts FIFO, shortfall reported) -> undo within 6s
Sales report: daily totals, sale/item counts, top sellers, shortfall flag
STACK: React 18 + Vite 6 + TypeScript strict + vite-plugin-pwa + Dexie 4 + @zxing/browser + lucide-react + vitest
Tutorial/onboarding (4 steps) and Replay Tutorial in Settings
Export (JSON) and Clear All Data flows
Seed data as code (506 Filipino grocery products)
GitHub Pages deploy pipeline and SPA 404 fallback
Offline-first behaviour (local catalog + service worker caching)
